column1: # The rule table tools/voice-lint.sh runs. Tab-separated. Lines starting # are comments.
# Columns: id / pattern / scope / case / threshold / route / why / source / hits / last_hit
#   pattern    POSIX extended regex, passed to grep after -e. No lookarounds: the matcher is grep,
#              so a rule that needs one is written as a code check in the script instead.
#   scope      all = prose and table cells. prose = lines that do not start with a pipe.
#              Headings, link text, URLs, HTML tags and quoted third-party copy are blanked out of
#              the copy every rule reads, so no row carries its own escape hatch.
#   threshold  report from the Nth occurrence onward. 1 for every rule but the two capped ones.
#   route      block = a finding, non-zero exit. truth = routed to the truth critic, exit unchanged.
#   hits       incremented by the compound step. 0 hits in 5 consecutive runs retires the row.
# Every row is measured GREEN on build/briefing.md and RED on its counter-example, and
# `bash tools/voice-lint.sh --selftest` is where both measurements run.
# A row that reds the exemplar does not land; see decisions.md for the three that did not.
